description: Pinned Rodinia 3.1 HotSpot pyramidal stencil with FP32 state and upstream mixed arithmetic, stability-limited timestep when required, fixed iteration counts and complete FP64 CPU verification.

non_scaling_params.name: total_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Fixed number of thermal time steps per process. Actual timestep and simulated duration are reported; limiting dt does not add steps.

non_scaling_params.name: pyramid_height
non_scaling_params.description: Time steps advanced per pyramidal launch (must be < BLOCK_SIZE/2 = 8)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run the vector-add warmer once before the timed trajectory. Subsequent dependent launches retain natural cache state; false disables the entry warmer.
